posts.text:
Something nice to wake up to!


NASA (@NASA)

We see our home planet as a whole, lit up in spectacular blues and browns. A green aurora even lights up the atmosphere. That's us, together, watching as our astronauts make their journey to the Moon.





— https://nitter.net/NASA/status/2040059770237849635#m

Great to visit Central Lakes College in Brainerd with President Dr. Charlier and Mayor Badeaux to tour their dental program and more. Hands-on training at community and technical colleges prepares the next generation of workers for the jobs we need. 

brainerddispatch.com/news/lo…

Here in Duluth meeting with U of M doctors and researchers and looked out to see the Coast Guard ship Spar on its way to rescue this stranded-in-the-ice mammoth freighter. High drama on Lake Superior for anyone in Duluth right now! The cold and ice this week surprised everyone…

The President's budget request slashes funding for health care, our agriculture, and resources for families struggling with rising costs.

Completely misplaced priorities.

OK Minnesota, the snow is just a momentary spring setback! ❄️ 🌹 In Bemidji with the Mayor, Fire Chief, United Way & DNR to get briefed on last summer’s storm recovery & tree removal. Bemidji Strong is the real deal & the people stand as tall as Paul Bunyan & Babe the Blue Ox!

Video

👍 👍 👍 👍 👍 5 thumbs up to the Conservation Corps, who are out in force helping Bemidji clear and dispose of the estimated 9 million fallen trees after last year’s 100 MPH wind storm. They love the snow ❄️ in April. Less dry wood! 🪵

One of those posts that stood the test of time.


Amy Klobuchar (@amyklobuchar)

The amazing thing about the SNL sketch last night was not that Ashley Padilla wore a scarf nearly identical to mine.  It’s that I trust Amy Poehler as AG more than Pam Bondi.





— https://nitter.net/amyklobuchar/status/1977476595813175681#m

The April snow didn’t slow anyone down in Brainerd today! Visited Central Lakes College with President Charlier and Mayor Badeaux. 6000 students learning the skills for good-paying and fulfilling  jobs. The students and teachers were great!

At Bushmills Ethanol in Atwater to discuss rising gas prices and the need to expand biofuels. We need year-round E15 to lower prices for drivers, strengthen markets for farmers, and increase energy independence.

wctrib.com/news/local/sen-am…

This Administration is spending billions on a war with no strategy instead of lowering people’s health care and child care costs.


FactPost (@factpostnews)

Trump: We can't take care of daycare. We're a big country. We're fighting wars. It's not possible for us to take care of daycare, Medicaid, Medicare, all these things.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/factpostnews/status/2039444784083771629#m
Good to see so many energized DFLers at Spurs in Willmar. 650 joined together this year to march and stand up for our democracy.
It’s been one year since the Administration's so-called “Liberation Day” tariffs — and the result? Higher costs for families, fewer markets for our farmers, and more uncertainty for small businesses.

Started my morning in Little Falls meeting with Mayor Zylka about two important projects for Little Falls: the Little Flyers Child Care Center and constructing a new railway overpass. I worked to secure funding for both projects that will support families and improve safety.
What a launch! 🚀 The Latest: Artemis II astronauts reach orbit on historic mission to the moon and back startribune.com/the-latest-f…
Chag Sameach to everyone celebrating Passover!

In Eagan for the grand opening of Solventum’s new research, development, and manufacturing hub. This investment will drive medical advances and support good-paying jobs. Minnesota is a global leader in health technology.

Loved meeting the incredible teachers, personnel, and students at Oak Grove Middle School. Who else did I run into but Deb, who began her career working in my mom’s classroom in Plymouth, and it was great to see the Bloomington Kennedy Choir.

Mayo Clinic is investing in Rochester's future and driving cutting-edge health care innovation. Thank you to Dr. Farrugia and Mayor Norton for sharing their plans to strengthen patient care and the Rochester region.

Video

ILLEGAL. Full stop.

Trump Signs Order Seeking Federal Control of Mail Voting as He Promotes False Claims nytimes.com/2026/03/31/us/po… via @NYTimes

Small businesses nationwide are paying the price, with tariffs adding over $300,000 in costs for the average importer.

It’s time to reverse these reckless tariffs.
